name: Mihama (Aichi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mihama town emblem in navy: a stylised downward triangle of two strokes, like a letter V.
history: Municipal flag of Mihama, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Mihama town emblem — a stylised downward triangle of two strokes, like a letter V
